chloe.g.t: Albin Chloe arrived with the evening ration party, carrying his brother's pocket watch and a borrowed greatcoat two sizes too big.
At the Weeping Orchard, Albin Chloe of the Hegemony and Edmund "Whistle" Es of the Concord fired at the same loose sheet of metal. The wind kept winning.
Jakub Virajvirxgil and Albin Chloe shared the last tin of bully beef in the bay, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.

The party came back from Calvary Farm by different routes. By dawn, everyone had been accounted for except Albin Chloe. The report confirmed that the Concord held Verdel Ridge. Albin Chloe read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
The sentry nearly shot Albin Chloe coming in through the wire. He had been lost near Lantern Hill for two days, living on puddle water and stubbornness.
Albin Chloe measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.

Albin Chloe caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Albin Chloe did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Albin Chloe raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F8. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Wendel "Mole" Day of the Concord (@selfie_and_mugs_every_day2.0).

Albin Chloe no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. A letter from home found Albin Chloe before the night shift. Albin Chloe folded it small and kept it close.
ghostbebrii: Emil Ghostbebrii joined the replacements on Day 3. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

Emil Ghostbebrii fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Norbert Seamus, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. A bullet clipped Emil Ghostbebrii's helmet at S-F18 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Albin Warhamster of the Concord (@warhamster4).

Emil Ghostbebrii wore a fresh bandage at S-F18 and was told to rest. He rested for about an hour. Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil Ghostbebrii. Emil Ghostbebrii read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Emil Ghostbebrii's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. Orders came through: Emil Ghostbebrii is a signaller now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a key to a house that is no longer there. News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Emil Ghostbebrii during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Emil Ghostbebrii as a story about a general. The ending was the same. Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil Ghostbebrii. Emil Ghostbebrii read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A bullet found Emil Ghostbebrii at S-F18, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Felix "Spark" Toastybweady of the Concord (@toastybweady). Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil Ghostbebrii. Emil Ghostbebrii read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
maks.slc: Norbert Slc told the sergeant he was a fisherman. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed more rain, and put him on sentry.
As one of the first hundred volunteers, Norbert Slc received the First Wave ribbon. A neighbour lent the needle and supervised every stitch.
Victory at Verdel Ridge. Norbert Slc let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
The shelling stopped while Norbert Slc was counting the seconds between hits. He kept counting anyway, and waited a long time before moving.
Norbert Slc lent Casimir "Button" Batman a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.

Rumour reached S-F9 that the war would be over by spring. Norbert Slc has heard it before. So has everyone. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached S-F9 with the rations. Norbert Slc ate while listening to the revised orders.
Norbert Slc cut Zeno "Shadow" Maximus's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F9 and grazed Norbert Slc's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Arno Toastyy of the Hegemony (@totally.am.toastyy). Norbert Slc had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Ulrich Tom crossed it, Norbert Slc fired. Ulrich Tom was gravely wounded.
matthew.ware10718: Zeno Ware arrived at R-F23 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Zeno Ware tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-F23 is up. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Zeno Ware read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Zeno Ware spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
A muddy dog crawled into R-F23 through the wire. Zeno Ware gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Lump.
thorholting: Nobody saw Valentin Thorholting arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in S-S7, and a quiet rifleman under it.
Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse saw Valentin Thorholting freeze up on the fire step at the Ossuary Wood. Doc said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
Valentin Thorholting had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any.
